_scenario: EOLIANITE ABRASIVITY SIMULATION SET - client order 2026-08-16 (CR.5009 panel Q4 follow-up: no measured abrasivity figures exist; simulate with aeolian-limestone figures). Rock model: aeolian carbonate dune rock (eolianite/calcarenite) - soft porous calcite matrix (UCS 15-30, consistent with the 2026-08-15 soft-rock and porosity rulings) cementing WELL-ROUNDED ~200 um QUARTZ grains inherited from dune transport. The quartz, not the matrix, governs steel wear: it is the only phase harder than any tool steel. EVERY number below is [H] literature-anchored, pending the external tests (XRF/mineralogy, LCPC, Cerchar, Bond Ai on real samples).

quartz_pct._note: [H] siliceous eolianites span near-pure carbonate to quartz-rich; 20 % central chosen as a defensible mid case - THE first number the XRF test must replace

quartz_grain_um._note: [H] client statement: ~200 um very round grains

porosity_pct._note: [H] consistent with the porous-stone moisture set 12/15/11 %

hardness_frame._note: quartz > any steel -> hard-abrasive regime (Khrushchov): wear is quartz-governed; calcite < steel -> mild. Rounded grains shift two-body cutting toward three-body rolling wear - lower metal cutting rate (-20 % applied on LCPC) but polishing wear on teeth and severe wear on POLYMER media (screen mats) and high-velocity surfaces (fan, classifier wheel)

cerchar_CAI._reliability: [H] CAI is UNRELIABLE on UCS < 25 MPa (pin ploughs the soft matrix instead of scratching) - quoted for completeness, LCPC governs

LCPC_ABR_g_per_t.basis: mixture rule quartz sand ~1700 g/t x 0.2 + soft limestone ~300 g/t x 0.8, minus ~20 % roundness allowance
LCPC_ABR_g_per_t._note: LCPC is THE right test for soft rock with hard fine grains - priority order over Cerchar

liberation_model._note: [H] quartz grains liberate as the calcite matrix is comminuted toward the grain scale; liberated free grains (100-400 um) travel with each stream's 0.1-0.4 mm band; embedded grains travel with the lumps

machine_severity_factors._note: [H] relative contact severity per machine class (velocity x pressure x steel/polymer sensitivity), used ONLY for ranking - not absolute life prediction

sizer_teeth_g_per_t._note: [H] order of magnitude for segment/tooth steel loss on ABR ~550 rock - RFQ wear-guarantee anchor, replaced by vendor guarantees priced on the real LCPC result

product_quality_frame._note: quartz does not calcine and does not neutralize: CaCO3-based product values dilute by the quartz content of each product - the KFS (kiln feed) chemistry question is raised to the client explicitly
